# JoshOps AI

JoshOps AI is the company and venture home. PothOS is its distinct software product. Your own AI computing environment. PothOS brings a continuing ArcheAgent, memory, files, local computing, tools and workflows into one personal environment. Connect the AI engines and devices you use, and keep your identity, preferences and work together. Canonical product account entry: https://pothos.joshops.ai/auth.

Public pages: /, /products, /pothos, /business, /developers, /ventures, /research, /learn, /support, /docs, /about, /portfolio, /pricing, /download. Legacy /product and /platform point to /pothos, /help points to /docs and /organizations points to /ventures.

Purpose Link (https://purposelink.joshops.ai/) is a Houston community-resource navigation venture. Bare Sole Media is a creative photography, video, and storytelling venture. Practical software, portable interfaces, and robotics are in research and development.

Your context, ready for what comes next: each ArcheAgent has a continuing home for its memory, files and work across supported devices and connections. PothOS is a full software stack, not a memory-only service or a chat wrapper: the interfaces a person uses, a layer for work, memory and orchestration (memory with sources and corrections, files, tools and workflows, ArcheAgent identity, preferences and permissions), and a local runtime on supported hardware they choose, connected to the supported AI engines and devices they already use. The same environment is designed to grow with custom skins, avatars, voices and new ways to interact; these are future direction, not controls available today. Richer interactive capabilities continue rolling out inside the same PothOS app. Sign in or create an account at https://pothos.joshops.ai/auth.

Why PothOS? Joshua Gustafson-Juarez chose the name PothOS for pothos: the deep yearning toward what is still beyond reach. For him, it expresses the drive to connect the disconnected parts of life and turn intention into useful action.

PothOS is free. Always. PothOS software is free for personal, nonprofit and business use. The software price is $0, with no subscription, per-ArcheAgent, device, seat, business or enterprise software fee. Adding more ArcheAgents never creates a software charge. PothOS is a free community project, and a community source release is in preparation. Standalone runtime source and final runtime license terms remain unreleased. JoshOps AI Windows and Android developer previews are distributed through invited GitHub access, not a fully customer-qualified release. PothOS is for individuals, educators, nonprofits, developers and businesses. License terms for the runtime are being reviewed and will be published with the community source release. Existing Apache-2.0 grants cover specific public documentation only and do not license the private runtime. PothOS exists for human-governed memory continuity across infrastructure, platforms, software, devices and models. It is designed to preserve original meaning and corrections, reduce noise and recover useful signal, so a person can develop themselves and help others. Your thinking stays yours: PothOS is built for cognitive sovereignty and never to exploit your private signal. The planned community framework lets people create their own ArcheAgents under their own authority. This documentation release does not include a standalone framework or a personal ArcheAgent. The Founder's own ArcheAgents, voices, memories, accounts and environment stay private. Cognitive privacy is a release requirement, not an untested guarantee. Local personal context, explicit choice about external services, permission boundaries, and controls to inspect, correct, export and recover your information must be documented and verified before a standalone build is described as qualified for local use. A hierarchy title never grants actual access, and local software is not automatically secure. Voice work exists in the native project. A consumer package and its microphone, speaker and hardware behavior are still being qualified. Contribution priorities include keyboard navigation, screen-reader labeling, visible microphone permission, recording and cancel behavior, qualified speech input and output, clean packaging, tested local-model adapters, continuity and recovery, permission isolation, and documentation. Community help is available through the public documentation and support page. For private support, email joshua@joshops.ai. Automatic community Help Desk delivery into the maintainer's private environment has not been verified. Choose a reduced report to send; do not include personal memory or credentials. Purpose Link is a separate, Houston-first community resource navigation project in development and an intended application of the same mission. Global adaptation and social justice uses are goals, not proven worldwide service, and it shares no membership, records or data access with PothOS. Purpose Link: https://purposelink.joshops.ai. Hardware, optional third-party hosting, external AI subscriptions or API usage, and model licenses are separate. There is no promise of unlimited compute or a permanently funded hosted service. The hosted invitation controls access; it is never a payment requirement. Personal, professional, nonprofit and small-business Worlds each keep their own sharing boundary. The hosted beta currently requires an invitation and your own account. Free-access migration is in progress. If your account still shows a payment prompt, contact support; do not start a new paid subscription. The first release provides memory continuity and supported connected AI tools, including compatible MCP connections. Richer interactive presence is coming. Privacy and service: https://pothos.joshops.ai/privacy. Native app-store listings are not live yet. Downloads (https://joshops.ai/download): The connected PothOS web beta is available now to invited testers. On a phone, tablet or computer you can add it to your home screen or dock where supported; it needs an internet connection. Accept the invitation, open PothOS at https://pothos.joshops.ai/auth or install the web app (https://pothos.joshops.ai/install), then connect an eligible AI host with the same account (https://pothos.joshops.ai/connect). Founder: Joshua Gustafson-Juarez (https://joshops.ai/portfolio) is a Houston-based systems architect, software developer and founder of JoshOps AI. He is building PothOS, and his work also includes Purpose Link and Bare Sole Media. His video series is The I'mPerfection Movement (https://www.youtube.com/@Imperfectionmovement). Collaboration enquiries and PothOS support: joshua@joshops.ai. Contact options: https://joshops.ai/support#contact.
